## Where Results Are Saved

All gap hunting results are now saved with **full prime numbers** to:
```
wolfram_proof/docs/gap_results/gaps_309digit_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.md
```

Each file includes:
- Timestamp and runtime
- Full 309-digit prime numbers for every gap > 2x expected
- Summary statistics
